remarks: Completely updated and move-in ready, this beautifully renovated condo at 105 Harbor Dr., Unit 112, offers modern finishes and a convenient coastal lifestyle. The unit features a fully updated kitchen with contemporary cabinetry, stone countertops, and stainless steel appliances, along with renovated bathrooms, updated flooring, fresh paint, and stylish fixtures throughout. The bright, open layout provides comfortable living and entertaining space, with excellent natural light and a 1-car garage near the unit entrance.  Additionally, this unit offers a loft perfect for an office and a walk-up storage room. Amenities include a clubhouse and a pool. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Stamford, Metro-North, I-95, shopping, restaurants, and waterfront parks, this home is perfect for local buyers, first-time homeowners, downsizers, and NYC commuters looking for convenience and value. Enjoy low-maintenance living in a desirable waterfront community with easy access to everything Stamford has to offer. Nothing to do but move right in.
